approvers: None, I decide alone; site foreman and glazing subcontractor would have a say
reason: I pay about €12 a m² now with film and my own lads, and you want €19 plus a 50% deposit up front. I have never seen this used on a Maltese site, and I am not paying more to be your first job.
objection: €19 against €12, and no local job I can go and look at. If it leaves residue on the aluminium or won't peel, I pay for that, not you.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and sheet with tape, put on and taken off by my own labour, for the next block.
would_change_my_mind: A finished block in Malta I can visit, with the owner telling me it came off clean, and a price close to what I pay now, with no deposit.
